DeadZone Framework Patcher — Third-Party Attribution
======================================================

Patch logic ported and adapted from:
  FrameworksForge/FrameworkPatcher
  https://github.com/FrameworksForge/FrameworkPatcher

Features ported:
  - Signature Verification Bypass (framework.jar, services.jar, miui-services.jar)
  - invoke-custom handling (equals, hashCode, toString method cleanup)

Ported to:
  scripts/deadzone_framework_patcher.py
  bin/modfile/UpdateFile/DeadZone_FrameworkPatcher/install.sh

Porting notes:
  - Bash sed/grep patching logic rewritten in Python for cross-platform reliability
  - Patch targets (method signatures and replacement types) match reference exactly
  - invoke-custom removal order and body replacement matches reference patching.sh
  - Tool management (apktool.jar v2.9.3 download + SHA256 check) matches reference
  - Features CN Notification Fix, Disable Secure Flag, Kaorios Toolbox, Gboard
    support, and Magisk module creation are NOT ported (out of scope)
